name: Ashe House
_plan: Tarin's house. Three generations, one room, and a map of Caelora on the wall with a pin in a town nobody here has ever been to. His mother is not in it and is not going to be: she keeps the Mirehaven Kin Hall, five regions of road away, and the house is arranged around her absence in a way nobody mentions.

npcs._note: Tarin is in exactly one place at a time. Up to the send-off he is here, wearing a hole in his father's floor; the moment Mira lets the player go he is out on the lane as hm_tarin in data/maps/hearthmere.json, which is gated the other way on the same flag.

text: Shelves of ledgers, every spine dated.
The Ashes have kept books in this house
since before there was a road to it.
A map of Caelora, and one pin, east, in the marshes.
MIREHAVEN, in a child's handwriting, gone brown at the edges.
The pin has been moved twice and put back both times.
A kitchen counter worn pale in one spot
where somebody has stood and chopped
at the same board for thirty years.
The table, laid for three, and three is the correct number.
It has been the correct number for eleven years
and Tarin still counts the chairs when he sits down.
The television is on with the sound off.
A coast survey boat, filmed from the air,
circling water that is the wrong colour.
Tarin's bag, packed, by the door. Packed a week ago.
Repacked twice since, both times at about four in the morning,
which you know because he told you at four in the morning.
Letters, bulldog-clipped by year. The clips get thinner.
The last one has three in it and it is nearly autumn.
